https://www.paulettemichelle.com/headsho.content:
Elevate your professional image with my expertly crafted Headshot Photo Sessions. Whether you’re an entrepreneur, actor, corporate executive, or looking to update your social media profile, I specialize in capturing headshots that convey confidence, approachability, and authenticity. My goal is to help you make a powerful first impression with a headshot that stands out.
What To Expect
Professional Headshots Starting at
$160
Pre-Session Consultation: Before your session, we'll have a brief consultation to discuss your goals and preferences. This can be done via phone, email, or in-person. We’ll talk about the intended use of your headshots (e.g., professional profile, corporate website, acting portfolio), your style preferences, and any specific requirements or guidelines you need to follow.
. Wardrobe and Styling Guidance: Choosing the right outfit is crucial for a great headshot. I’ll provide you with tips and suggestions on what to wear to ensure you look your best. Whether you need a formal, business-casual, or creative look, I’ll help you select clothing that complements your personal style and the purpose of your headshots.
. Comfortable and Relaxed Environment: Your comfort is essential for capturing authentic, confident headshots. Sessions take place in my studio. I strive to create a relaxed atmosphere where you can feel at ease and focus on presenting your best self.
. Guided Posing and Expression: No need to worry about posing! I will guide you through various poses and expressions to capture your best angles. My goal is to highlight your personality and ensure your headshots convey the right message—whether it’s approachability, confidence, or creativity.
. High-Quality Photography: Using top-of-the-line equipment and professional lighting techniques. Each shot is taken with care to ensure clarity, sharpness, and optimal lighting.
. Review and Selection: After the session, we’ll review the images together so you can select your favorites. I’ll provide my professional input to help you choose the best shots that meet your needs and goals.
. Professional Editing: Your selected images will undergo professional editing to enhance their quality. This includes color correction, retouching, and any necessary adjustments to ensure your headshots are polished and ready for use. The editing process is handled with care to maintain a natural look.
. Final Delivery: Once editing is complete, your final headshots will be delivered in high-resolution digital format. You’ll receive files suitable for both print and online use, ensuring you have versatile images for all your professional needs.

https://www.paulettemichelle.com/paulett.content:
Hey there, I’m Paulette!
I’m a portrait photographer based in Northeast Pennsylvania, and I see the world a little differently, I see it through a lens filled with magic, emotion, and story. Photography, for me, isn’t just about snapping pictures; it’s about capturing the feeling of a moment, the spark of a personality, and the beauty in everyday life.
NEPA is my home and my inspiration. The rolling hills, the changing seasons, the golden light filtering through the trees…it all feeds my creativity. But more than the landscapes, it’s the people who make this place special. Whether I’m photographing an artist lost in their craft, a couple in love, or a quiet, powerful portrait, my goal is always the same: to create images that feel like memories, not just pictures.
My journey with photography has been an adventure of growth, storytelling, and chasing the perfect light. Over the years, I’ve refined my craft, learning how to shape light, compose stories, and bring out authentic emotions in my subjects. I believe that every photograph should tell a story, and that’s exactly what I strive for in every session.
So, take a look around. Whether you’re here to find a photographer, get inspired, or just explore the world through my lens, welcome. Let’s create something unforgettable together.

https://www.paulettemichelle.com/my-work.content:
Welcome to the world of Creative Dream Photo Shoots, where imagination meets artistry! These sessions are all about bringing your wildest dreams and fantasies to life through stunning, ethereal photography.
What To Expect
Dream Sessions starting at $300
1. Personalized Consultation: Before the shoot, we’ll have a personalized consultation to discuss your vision, ideas, and goals. Whether you envision yourself as a mystical fairy, a courageous knight, or a character from your favorite storybook, I want to understand your dream thoroughly to create a session that perfectly captures it.
2. Concept and Planning: Based on our discussion, I’ll help you plan every detail of the shoot. This includes choosing the right theme, location, costumes, props, and accessories. I’ll provide guidance and suggestions to ensure that every element aligns with your vision.
3. Wardrobe and Styling: Your wardrobe and styling play a crucial role in bringing your dream to life. I’ll assist you in selecting or creating outfits that reflect the theme of your shoot.
4. Location Selection: The right location can transform a good photo into a magical one. Whether it’s a lush forest, a serene beach, an ancient castle, or a whimsical garden, we’ll choose a setting that enhances the overall theme and mood of your shoot.
5. Professional Guidance: On the day of the shoot, I’ll guide you through poses and expressions to ensure you feel comfortable and confident. My goal is to capture your best angles and moments while allowing your personality and creativity to shine through.
6. Capturing the Magic: Using top-of-the-line equipment and techniques, I’ll capture a series of stunning, high-quality images that reflect the magic and wonder of your dream. I pay close attention to lighting, composition, and details to ensure each shot is perfect.
7. Post-Processing and Editing: After the shoot, I’ll carefully select and edit the best images to enhance their magical qualities. This includes adding special effects, adjusting colors, and ensuring every photo meets the highest artistic standards.
8. Viewing and Delivery: Once the editing is complete, we’ll schedule a viewing session where you can see your beautifully crafted images. You’ll have the opportunity to choose your favorites and decide how you’d like to display them—whether in a custom-designed album, as high-quality prints, or in a digital gallery.
9. Creating Lasting Memories: A Creative Dream Photo Shoot is more than just a photography session—it’s an experience that allows you to step into a world of fantasy and creativity. The final images will be timeless pieces of art that you’ll cherish forever, capturing the essence of your dreams and imagination.

Whether you're a small, tight-knit group or a bustling, extended group, I aim to encapsulate the love, joy, and connection that make your family special. My sessions are relaxed, fun, and designed to bring out the genuine smiles and candid moments that you'll cherish for a lifetime.

. Choosing the Right Location: Selecting the perfect location is key to capturing the essence of your family. Whether it’s a favorite park, your home, a scenic outdoor spot, or my studio, we’ll choose a setting that best reflects your family’s personality and style.

https://www.paulettemichelle.com/creativ.content:
Discover the magic of personalized photography with my Creative Portrait Photo Sessions. These sessions are designed to highlight your individuality and creativity without the extensive planning required for a themed dream shoot. Perfect for those looking to capture beautiful, unique portraits with a touch of artistry.
What To Expect
Creative Portraits starting at $275
1. Initial Consultation: I start with a brief consultation to understand your vision and preferences. Whether you’re looking for professional headshots with a creative twist, family portraits with a unique flair, or personal portraits that stand out, I’ll tailor the session to meet your needs.
2. Concept and Styling: Based on our discussion, I’ll develop a simple yet creative concept that reflects your personality. This might include selecting a color scheme, incorporating a few meaningful props, or choosing an interesting location that adds character to your portraits. I’ll provide guidance on wardrobe choices to complement the theme.
3. Location Selection: Choose from a variety of picturesque locations, whether it’s a serene park, an urban setting, or my versatile studio. The right location will enhance the artistic quality of your portraits without the need for extensive setup.
4. Professional Guidance: During the session, I provide professional guidance on posing and expression to ensure you look and feel your best. My goal is to capture natural, candid moments as well as posed shots that reflect your unique style.
5. Artistic Photography: Using high-quality equipment and creative techniques, I capture stunning portraits that emphasize your individuality. I focus on lighting, composition, and angles to create images that are both beautiful and distinctive.
6. Post-Processing and Editing: After the shoot, your photos will be carefully edited to enhance their artistic quality. This includes color correction, retouching, and any necessary adjustments to ensure each image meets my high standards.
7. Viewing and Selection: I’ll schedule a viewing session where you can review your beautifully edited portraits. You’ll have the opportunity to select your favorite images and decide how you’d like to display them, whether through high-quality prints, digital galleries, or custom-designed albums.
8. Simple Yet Memorable: My Creative Portrait Photo Sessions are designed to provide you with stunning, personalized images without the need for extensive planning. The final portraits will be timeless pieces that capture your personality and creativity in a memorable way.
